why_not_winning: Every winner had a demo link; you have none.
Winners measured something. You say 'better' without a single number.
You claim Best Use of Sentry, but there is no Sentry anywhere in your code.
top_fixes: Deploy it (a free tier is fine) and put the live link in the first three lines.
Pick one person with one messy note, and show the before and after with a number: time saved, words cut, errors fixed.
Either add Sentry for real (SDK, DSN, one traced model call) or remove the claim. The jury checks.
better_title: I Turned 30 Minutes of Messy Lecture Notes Into a 5-Minute Study Sheet With an Open Model
better_opening: Every Sunday I lost half an hour rewriting my lecture notes. So I built a small app on an open-weight model that turns a messy page into a study sheet: headings, key terms, three practice questions. On my last ten lectures it saved 25 minutes each. Try it live, then read how it works.
count_says: Objection. To all of it. I have watched empires fall with more structure than your README, mortal. Three fixes. Then we shall speak again.
voice_line: Objection. To all of it. I have watched empires fall with more structure than your README, mortal. Three fixes. Then we shall speak again. Overall: 38 out of one hundred.
